---
title: "Mentoring"
---

The table below is generated from `mentoring.bib` and supports instant search and column sorting.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.dataTables.min.css">
<script src="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.min.js"></script>

<div id="mentor-load-status">Loading mentoring records from mentoring.bib...</div>

<figure class="chart-figure" aria-label="Bar chart: mentees by category">
	<canvas id="mentor-chart" role="img" aria-label="Bar chart showing number of mentees by category"></canvas>
	<figcaption id="mentor-chart-caption" class="chart-caption"></figcaption>
</figure>

<div id="mentor-filters" style="display:none"></div>

<table id="mentor-table" class="display accessible-table" style="width:100%" aria-label="Mentoring records">
	<caption class="visually-hidden">Mentoring records with year, mentee, category, summary, and source.</caption>
	<thead>
		<tr>
			<th scope="col">Year</th>
			<th scope="col">Mentee</th>
			<th scope="col">Category</th>
			<th scope="col">Summary</th>
			<th scope="col">Source</th>
		</tr>
	</thead>
	<tbody></tbody>
</table>

<script>
const drawBarChart = (canvasEl, labels, values, { rotateLabels = false, barColor = null } = {}) => {
	const isDark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
	const primary = isDark ? "#fac800" : "#990000";
	const textColor = isDark ? "#c9c9c9" : "#444444";
	const gridColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.08)";
	const axisColor = isDark ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" : "rgba(0,0,0,0.18)";
	const bar = barColor || primary;

	const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
	const W = Math.max(canvasEl.parentElement?.clientWidth || 640, 320);
	const padB = rotateLabels ? 72 : 48;
	const H = 300;
	const padL = 48, padR = 16, padT = 30;
	const cW = W - padL - padR;
	const cH = H - padT - padB;

	canvasEl.width = W * dpr;
	canvasEl.height = H * dpr;
	canvasEl.style.width = W + "px";
	canvasEl.style.height = H + "px";

	const ctx = canvasEl.getContext("2d");
	ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

	const maxVal = Math.max(...values, 1);
	const niceMax = Math.ceil(maxVal / 5) * 5 || 5;
	const nTicks = 5;

	for (let t = 0; t <= nTicks; t++) {
		const v = (t / nTicks) * niceMax;
		const y = padT + cH - (v / niceMax) * cH;
		ctx.strokeStyle = gridColor;
		ctx.lineWidth = 1;
		ctx.beginPath();
		ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
		ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, y);
		ctx.stroke();
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
		ctx.textAlign = "right";
		ctx.fillText(Math.round(v), padL - 6, y + 4);
	}

	const n = labels.length;
	const slot = cW / n;
	const barW = Math.max(slot * 0.65, 4);
	const barOffset = (slot - barW) / 2;

	labels.forEach((lbl, i) => {
		const val = values[i];
		const bH = Math.max((val / niceMax) * cH, 0);
		const x = padL + slot * i + barOffset;
		const y = padT + cH - bH;

		ctx.fillStyle = bar;
		ctx.fillRect(x, y, barW, bH);

		if (val > 0) {
			ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
			ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
			ctx.fillText(val, x + barW / 2, Math.max(y - 5, padT + 12));
		}

		ctx.save();
		ctx.translate(x + barW / 2, padT + cH + 10);
		if (rotateLabels) {
			ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 4);
			ctx.textAlign = "right";
		} else {
			ctx.textAlign = "center";
		}
		ctx.fillStyle = textColor;
		ctx.font = "11px sans-serif";
		ctx.fillText(lbl, 0, 0);
		ctx.restore();
	});

	ctx.strokeStyle = axisColor;
	ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
	ctx.beginPath();
	ctx.moveTo(padL, padT);
	ctx.lineTo(padL, padT + cH);
	ctx.lineTo(padL + cW, padT + cH);
	ctx.stroke();
};

const CATEGORY_LABELS = {
	"Undergraduate Scholars": "Undergraduate",
	"Graduate Student Mentoring": "Graduate",
	"Postdoctoral Education Scholar Mentoring": "Postdoctoral",
};

const renderMentoringChart = (rows) => {
	const canvas = document.getElementById("mentor-chart");
	const caption = document.getElementById("mentor-chart-caption");
	if (!canvas) return;

	const counts = { Undergraduate: 0, Graduate: 0, Postdoctoral: 0 };
	rows.forEach(({ category }) => {
		const short = CATEGORY_LABELS[category];
		if (short) counts[short] += 1;
	});

	const labels = ["Undergraduate", "Graduate", "Postdoctoral", "Total"];
	const total = counts.Undergraduate + counts.Graduate + counts.Postdoctoral;
	const values = [counts.Undergraduate, counts.Graduate, counts.Postdoctoral, total];

	drawBarChart(canvas, labels, values);

	if (caption) {
		caption.textContent = `Mentees by category: Undergraduate (${counts.Undergraduate}), Graduate (${counts.Graduate}), Postdoctoral (${counts.Postdoctoral}), Total (${total}).`;
	}
};

const cleanField = (value) => {
	if (!value) return "";
	const asText = String(value)
		.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
		.replace(/[{}]/g, "")
		.replace(/\\[a-zA-Z]+\s*/g, "")
		.replace(/\s+/g, " ")
		.trim();

	const decode = document.createElement("textarea");
	decode.innerHTML = asText;
	return decode.value;
};

const escapeRegex = (value) => String(value).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const createDataTable = (selector, options) => {
	if (typeof window.DataTable === "function") {
		return new window.DataTable(selector, options);
	}

	if (window.jQuery?.fn?.DataTable) {
		return window.jQuery(selector).DataTable(options);
	}

	return null;
};

const enableBasicColumnSorting = (tableElement, { numericColumns = [], disabledColumns = [], defaultOrder = null } = {}) => {
	const headers = Array.from(tableElement.querySelectorAll("thead th"));
	const tbodyElement = tableElement.querySelector("tbody");
	if (!tbodyElement || headers.length === 0) return;

	const rowsForColumn = (columnIndex) =>
		Array.from(tbodyElement.querySelectorAll("tr")).map((row) => {
			const cell = row.children[columnIndex];
			const raw = (cell?.textContent || "").trim();
			const numeric = Number(raw.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ""));
			return {
				row,
				raw,
				normalized: numericColumns.includes(columnIndex) && Number.isFinite(numeric)
					? numeric
					: raw.toLowerCase()
			};
		});

	const sortByColumn = (columnIndex, direction) => {
		const rows = rowsForColumn(columnIndex);
		rows.sort((a, b) => {
			if (a.normalized < b.normalized) return direction === "asc" ? -1 : 1;
			if (a.normalized > b.normalized) return direction === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
			return 0;
		});
		tbodyElement.replaceChildren(...rows.map(({ row }) => row));
		headers.forEach((header, index) => {
			header.dataset.sortDir = index === columnIndex ? direction : "";
			header.setAttribute("aria-sort", index === columnIndex ? (direction === "asc" ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none");
		});
	};

	headers.forEach((header, index) => {
		if (disabledColumns.includes(index)) return;
		header.tabIndex = 0;
		header.style.cursor = "pointer";
		header.setAttribute("aria-sort", "none");

		const onSort = () => {
			const nextDirection = header.dataset.sortDir === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";
			sortByColumn(index, nextDirection);
		};

		header.addEventListener("click", onSort);
		header.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
			if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
				event.preventDefault();
				onSort();
			}
		});
	});

	if (defaultOrder) {
		sortByColumn(defaultOrder.column, defaultOrder.direction);
	}
};

const parseBibEntries = (text) => {
	const entries = [];
	const normalized = String(text || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
	let index = 0;

	const skipWhitespace = () => {
		while (index < normalized.length && /\s/.test(normalized[index])) {
			index += 1;
		}
	};

	const readUntil = (terminator) => {
		const start = index;
		while (index < normalized.length && normalized[index] !== terminator) {
			index += 1;
		}
		return normalized.slice(start, index);
	};

	const readBalancedBlock = (openChar, closeChar) => {
		let depth = 1;
		const start = index;
		while (index < normalized.length) {
			const char = normalized[index];
			if (char === openChar) depth += 1;
			if (char === closeChar) depth -= 1;
			index += 1;
			if (depth === 0) break;
		}
		return normalized.slice(start, index - 1);
	};

	const parseFields = (body) => {
		const fields = {};
		let i = 0;

		const skipFieldWhitespace = () => {
			while (i < body.length && /\s/.test(body[i])) i += 1;
		};

		const readFieldValue = () => {
			skipFieldWhitespace();

			if (body[i] === "{") {
				i += 1;
				let depth = 1;
				const start = i;
				while (i < body.length) {
					const char = body[i];
					if (char === "{") depth += 1;
					if (char === "}") depth -= 1;
					i += 1;
					if (depth === 0) break;
				}
				return body.slice(start, i - 1);
			}

			if (body[i] === '"') {
				i += 1;
				const start = i;
				while (i < body.length) {
					if (body[i] === '"' && body[i - 1] !== "\\") break;
					i += 1;
				}
				const value = body.slice(start, i);
				i += 1;
				return value;
			}

			const start = i;
			while (i < body.length && body[i] !== ",") i += 1;
			return body.slice(start, i).trim();
		};

		while (i < body.length) {
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (i >= body.length) break;

			const keyStart = i;
			while (i < body.length && /[\w\-]/.test(body[i])) i += 1;
			const key = body.slice(keyStart, i).trim();

			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] !== "=") break;

			i += 1;
			const value = readFieldValue();
			if (key) fields[key] = value;

			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] === ",") i += 1;
		}

		return fields;
	};

	while (index < normalized.length) {
		const at = normalized.indexOf("@", index);
		if (at === -1) break;
		index = at + 1;
		skipWhitespace();

		const typeStart = index;
		while (index < normalized.length && /[A-Za-z]/.test(normalized[index])) index += 1;
		const entryType = normalized.slice(typeStart, index).toLowerCase();

		skipWhitespace();
		if (normalized[index] !== "{") continue;
		index += 1;

		const key = readUntil(",").trim();
		if (normalized[index] === ",") index += 1;

		const body = readBalancedBlock("{", "}");
		const entryTags = parseFields(body);
		entries.push({ entryType, citationKey: key, entryTags });
	}

	return entries;
};

const loadMentoring = async () => {
	const status = document.getElementById("mentor-load-status");
	const tbody = document.querySelector("#mentor-table tbody");
	const filters = document.getElementById("mentor-filters");

	const yearLabel = document.createElement("label");
	yearLabel.htmlFor = "mentor-year-filter";
	yearLabel.textContent = "Year: ";
	const yearFilter = document.createElement("select");
	yearFilter.id = "mentor-year-filter";
	yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter mentoring records by year");
	yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "mentor-table");
	yearFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>';
	yearLabel.appendChild(yearFilter);

	const categoryLabel = document.createElement("label");
	categoryLabel.htmlFor = "mentor-category-filter";
	categoryLabel.textContent = "Category: ";
	const categoryFilter = document.createElement("select");
	categoryFilter.id = "mentor-category-filter";
	categoryFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter mentoring records by category");
	categoryFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "mentor-table");
	categoryFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>';
	categoryLabel.appendChild(categoryFilter);

	try {
		const response = await fetch("mentoring.bib");
		if (!response.ok) {
			throw new Error(`Could not load mentoring.bib (HTTP ${response.status})`);
		}

		const bibText = await response.text();
		const entries = parseBibEntries(bibText);

		const rows = entries.map((entry) => {
			const fields = entry.entryTags || {};
			const year = cleanField(fields.year || "");
			const mentee = cleanField(fields.author || "");
			const category = cleanField(fields.howpublished || "");
			const summary = cleanField(fields.note || "");
			const source = cleanField(fields.source || "");
			return { year, mentee, category, summary, source };
		});

		rows.sort((a, b) => Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0));

		renderMentoringChart(rows);

		const years = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.year).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
		const categories = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.category).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

		years.forEach((year) => {
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.value = year;
			option.textContent = year;
			yearFilter.appendChild(option);
		});

		categories.forEach((category) => {
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.value = category;
			option.textContent = category;
			categoryFilter.appendChild(option);
		});

		filters.replaceChildren(yearLabel, categoryLabel);

		tbody.innerHTML = rows
			.map((row) => {
				const safeSource = row.source
					? `<a href="${row.source}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Source for ${row.mentee}">Source</a>`
					: "";

				return `
					<tr>
						<td>${row.year}</td>
						<th scope="row">${row.mentee}</th>
						<td>${row.category}</td>
						<td>${row.summary}</td>
						<td>${safeSource}</td>
					</tr>
				`;
			})
			.join("");

		const table = createDataTable("#mentor-table", {
			pageLength: 25,
			order: [[0, "desc"]],
			columnDefs: [
				{ targets: 0, type: "num", orderable: true },
				{ targets: [1, 2, 3], orderable: true },
				{ targets: 4, orderable: false }
			]
		});

		if (!table) {
			enableBasicColumnSorting(document.getElementById("mentor-table"), {
				numericColumns: [0],
				disabledColumns: [4],
				defaultOrder: { column: 0, direction: "desc" }
			});
			status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} mentoring records from mentoring.bib. DataTables did not load, so basic column sorting is enabled.`;
			return;
		}

		const applyFilters = () => {
			const yearValue = yearFilter.value;
			const categoryValue = categoryFilter.value;

			table.column(0).search(yearValue ? `^${escapeRegex(yearValue)}$` : "", true, false);
			table.column(2).search(categoryValue ? `^${escapeRegex(categoryValue)}$` : "", true, false);
			table.draw();
		};

		yearFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		categoryFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		filters.style.display = "block";

		status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} mentoring records from mentoring.bib.`;
	} catch (error) {
		status.textContent = `Unable to load mentoring records: ${error.message}`;
	}
};

loadMentoring();
</script>
